Overview.Name: V Sangamesh
Overview.Goal: Fat loss, better appearance, increased energy, confidence, health improvement, and stress reduction.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + 2 boiled eggs
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat curd (150 g)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat milk (200 ml)
Breakfast: Option 1: Omelette (3 eggs) with vegetables (50 g) + small bowl curd (100 g)
Option 2: Boiled eggs (3) + rice poha (80 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + curd (150 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + egg curry (3 eggs) + dal (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: Plain rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (150 g)
Option 3: Plain rice (150 g) + paneer curry (150 g) + leafy vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (30 g) with boiled chickpeas (50 g) + cucumber (50 g)
Option 2: Roasted makhana (30 g) + small fruit (100 g)
Option 3: Boiled green gram (50 g) with tomato (50 g) and cucumber (50 g) + lemon
Dinner: Option 1: Egg curry (3 eggs) + rice (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Dal (150 g) + rice (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (150 g)
Option 3: Paneer curry (150 g) + rice (100 g) + leafy vegetable fry (100 g) + buttermilk (150 ml)

Notes_and_Tips: Keep salt very moderate; avoid pickles, papad, and processed foods.
Use eggs, paneer, and dal as primary protein sources for fat loss.
For sweet cravings, choose fruit with curd or a small piece of jaggery.
Prepare easy snacks (puffed rice, makhana, boiled chickpeas) for irregular hours.
Maintain consistency with three balanced meals daily.
Monitor portion sizes of rice and fried foods to control calories.
